method.method_draft: Use a coordinate setup. From the image, read that the rectangle is wider than tall, with the left circle tangent to the left, top, and bottom sides, and the right circle tangent to the right, top, and bottom sides. From the text, take the rectangle dimensions as height 7 cm and width 11 cm. Since each circle touches the top and bottom sides, each circle has diameter 7 cm and radius 3.5 cm. Place the rectangle with corners at (0,0), (11,0), (11,7), (0,7). Then the left circle center is 3.5 cm from the left side and midway vertically, at (3.5,3.5), while the right circle center is 3.5 cm from the right side and midway vertically, at (11-3.5,3.5) = (7.5,3.5). The distance between centers is the horizontal difference, 7.5 - 3.5 = 4 cm.
